mentions.name: Distributed object storage system
mentions.description: A self-built distributed object storage system designed to serve as the backing store behind a personal website, replacing the currently used Backblaze B2 service.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a distributed object storage system to be the backing store behind my website (https://scmscx.com). It currently uses back blaze b2 which is good and cheap but I thought it would be fun to roll my own.
